bookRaw: 因为天线是水平的，电场强度矢量也处于水平位置，因此，磁感应强度矢量是竖直的。
sourceReason: The approved prompt requires a qualified conclusion. The book's unconditional abbreviation is insufficient without added wave, propagation and polarization-matching assumptions.
reasoning: Actual pixels establish a drawn horizontal crossbar and structural/feed strokes, not incident-wave direction or polarization.
For a homogeneous isotropic far-field plane wave, transversality and B = kHat cross E / v hold.
An ideal receiving rod responds to the axial electric-field component; nonzero reception does not establish full polarization alignment.
Matched horizontal E plus horizontal transverse propagation yields vertical B.
Tilted propagation can defeat vertical B even when E matches the horizontal rod.
Unmatched polarization can defeat vertical B even with horizontal propagation and nonzero axial electric response.
Propagation reversal and alternating field phase leave instantaneous upward/downward sign undetermined by the picture.
coordinateConvention: Constructed right-handed x/y/z frame: x along a physically horizontal receiving axis, z vertically upward. Not a coordinate measurement extracted from the figure.
vectorInterpretation: k, E and Bdirection below are arbitrary dimensionless direction representatives for logical witnesses, not measured vectors, wave amplitudes, station locations or added problem data. Normalize k when using B = kHat cross E / v; the positive scale does not change the direction.

cases.interpretation: Under all stated assumptions, B has a vertical axis.
E matches the horizontal rod, but tilted transverse propagation gives B a horizontal component.
Horizontal propagation and a nonzero receiving component do not imply matched polarization or vertical B.
Reversing propagation reverses the instantaneous B sign without changing its vertical axis.
